contea di ritrovamento: Shropshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Heavily worn radiate of Postumous (AD 259-68) emperor with an uncertain reverse. Reece Period: 13-14. Obverse description: Bust of a male figure, radiate and cuirassed, right. Obverse inscription: [IMP] C PO[STVMVS PF AVG]. Reverse description: Unknown - standing figure - possibly a standing soldier with a globe and spear. Reverse inscription: [... ].
